name: FTP Ramp Test
description: Ramp test: 5 minutes at 50% FTP, then a continuous ramp from 50% to 250% over 25 minutes. Ride until you can no longer hold the step — when you stop pedaling the ERG guard drops the resistance, and your best 60 s is already recorded. Estimated FTP = 0.75 x your best 60-second power (ramp-test protocol).
